tier1.title: 1. ARTEX AI, Claude agents used in cyberattacks on South Korean banks

fields.label: Source & Article Link
fields.value: BleepingComputer

fields.label: Technical Severity / Domain
fields.value: Financial Sector / Novel Threat Vector (Active Exploitation)

fields.label: Why You Must Read This
fields.value: A Chinese threat actor utilized the ARTEX AI penetration testing suite and Anthropic Claude agents to attack South Korean financial institutions. This incident demonstrates a direct real-world shift toward threat actors leveraging autonomous AI agents to conduct attacks against critical banking infrastructure. Financial sector organizations must immediately evaluate potential agentic threat vectors and monitor for abnormal automated API traffic.

fields.label: Recommended Immediate Action
fields.value: Audit external boundaries for unauthorized AI agent traffic, enforce strict API authentication, and apply behavior-based network anti-automation controls.
